views.name: Backlog
views.purpose: Ready work selected by the agent on a start request, honoring PM direction and configured priority.

views.name: Kanban
views.purpose: Full Backlog to Done lifecycle with the active slot visible.

workflows.name: Pull request merged
workflows.reason: Merge is not verified release completion or PM acceptance.

automationLimits: QA waiting and incoming pickup remain In Progress on the same active Issue; only the PM may request On Hold.

The Issue evidence records ordered QA turns, current and next owner/environment, exact candidate, suite and PM state, and cleanup. Assignee follows the current baton owner; do not infer owner from OS.
QA completion never auto-closes an Issue. All configured release and PM completion gates remain required.
Agents discover field and option identifiers at runtime instead of hard-coding GraphQL IDs.
Agents own lifecycle movement and immediately read every mutation back.
Project copy is preferred because GitHub does not expose complete view and built-in workflow authoring through the public CLI.
